answer: Anchor each identity to one mobile number verified through the carrier, not an SMS code an agent can farm. The carrier attests the line is a postpaid account and re-checks it on any SIM swap; a swapped line loses standing until re-verified. A number is like a plume: cheap to display, hard to fake at scale, because each line carries billing history and a device trail. Sybils that harbor many identities behind one number are merged into one, their pooled standing slashed. The kernel is cost asymmetry: one line is cheap, but thousands of lines cost far more than a fake identity can earn.
